::: {.lead}
Houston Texans finished 2025 at 12&ndash;5. The model grades them as a defense-led: middling offence, top-quartile defence. Wins are real but the ceiling is set by the quarterback.
:::

## What the four phases look like

::: {.sec-note}
EPA **per play** in each of the four phases. Blue is creating points, red is costing them. Defence is sign-flipped so longer blue always means better. All four bars share one league-wide scale (max 0.306 EPA/play), so they are comparable to each other *and* to every other team page. Season totals are deliberately not used here &mdash; mixing totals and per-play rates on one axis would make the offence bars look four times longer than they are.
:::

## Identity

This team classifies as **Defense-Led** &mdash; *Middling offence, top-quartile defence. Wins are real but the ceiling is set by the quarterback.*

Underneath, the offence reads as **"Both Phases Broken"**: the label describes how the offence distributes its production between the run and the pass, not how good it is.

| Dimension | Grade |
|---|---|
| Offence tier | **Competent** |
| Defence tier | **Elite** |
| Pass defence rank | **#1** |
| Rush defence rank | **#4** |
| Wins above / below model | **+0.6** |

## Personnel

**Quarterback.** **C.Stroud** closed the season at **0.159 EPA per dropback** and **-0.6% CPOE** over his rolling five-game window (through week 20).

**Running back.** **W.Marks** led the backfield with **225 carries** at **-0.154 EPA per rush** (3.7 YPC, 36.0% success). Blocking versus creation: **1.8** yards before contact, **1.8** after. Style: *Contact creator*.

## 2026 outlook

The multi-year prior model projects **8.5 wins** for 2026, with a 90% interval of **2.0 to 15.1**. Fragility flag: **Neutral**.
